_comment: Tier 1 = structured feeds, no scraping. Every entry here is an ASSUMPTION until careeros/verify_sources.py proves it. The 'verified' field is written by that script, never by hand.

sources.name: RemoteOK
sources.notes: First array element is a legal disclaimer object, not a job. Skip it.

sources.name: WeWorkRemotely (all jobs)
sources.notes: Category-specific feeds also exist if the combined feed is unavailable.

sources.name: WeWorkRemotely (programming)
sources.notes: Fallback if the combined feed fails.

sources.name: Hacker News Who Is Hiring
sources.notes: Two-step: find the newest monthly thread, then fetch its comments via tags=comment,story_<objectID>.

sources.name: Himalayas
sources.notes: The only source that states location and timezone as DATA: locationRestrictions is a country list, timezoneRestrictions a list of UTC offsets. Everything else makes the pipeline guess that from a title. limit is capped server-side around 20 regardless of what is asked.

sources.name: Jobicy
sources.notes: Best published-salary coverage measured: 52% on 2026-08-17 against RemoteOK's 4% the same day. Jobs under the 'jobs' key. salaryPeriod can be monthly or hourly — sources._period_salary handles it.
